gold_routing_table.routing_rationale: Simultaneous cost and schedule impact on this project routes first to the Owner's Representative per the delegation-of-authority letter, with the Plumbing/Fire Protection Engineer looped in as technical reviewer.
gold_routing_table.divergence_reason: Default discipline routing would keep this with the Plumbing/Fire Protection Engineer; this project's delegation letter pulls the owner's rep in whenever both cost and schedule are affected, regardless of discipline.

gold_routing_table.routing_rationale: Urgent field conditions with a schedule impact route to the GC Superintendent for immediate field-level coordination.
Urgent field conditions without a schedule impact escalate directly to the Plumbing/Fire Protection Engineer.
Default discipline routing: the Plumbing/Fire Protection Engineer resolves field conditions affecting fire protection work.
